name: KH1FM Dual Styles Prototype v9
exclusivity: Equipping either disables the previous style in place; saved choice survives model suspension.
close: Existing v8 Valor/native ability priority, Guard attack, Final glides, default KH1 casting.
ranged: Matching Final non-melee visuals and ground/air KH1 cast overlays. No imported melee controller.
ranged_attack_block: Menu fill/selection, command dispatch and native attack-row execution; physical specials/offer/follow-ups blocked.
ranged_floating_contacts: Actual equipped-blade geometry and current authored Final weapon1/weapon2 Hitbox windows; no scene, body or donor spell hits.
native_spell_logic: Unchanged; existing KH1 MP, level, rate/recovery, targets, projectiles, FX/sound and damage.
native_ability_records: Copied byte-for-byte; no additional native ability grants.
offhand_only_test: Retained for both imported contact styles; off tests both blades.
limitations: Live ability-menu exclusivity and native input paths need game testing.
Final appearance/cast sync/floating weapon contacts and transitions need game testing.
Missing donor data falls back to native visuals.
